description: A budget.set that would leave the row with NO cap at all: a budget with no dimension is a no-op, and a no-op row is a row that enforces nothing and reads as if it were a cap — the store refuses it by name (data.kind no-dimension) rather than letting a hollow budget exist. The refusal is a store-level backstop: a set that clears the last dimension of an existing row lands on the same kind, because clearing a dimension is a removal, and removals are budget.remove's door.

data.what: budget set refused: a budget needs at least one cap (usd, tokens, wall-time or steps)
data.means: the daemon understood and declined — no budget row was written and nothing moved
